corrections.reason: The initial character is 6th-order እ (እሱም 'he also'), where ink fill on the central bend made it resemble 1st-order አ.
The gerundive form across the line wrap is ተሸክመህ ('having carried'), printed with 6th-order ክ rather than 1st-order ከ.

corrections.old_text: ል ተሠውሮ ነበርና ይህ ቆሎ ከ
corrections.corrected_text: ል ተሠውሮ ነበርና ይህ ሁሉ ከ
corrections.reason: Both visually and contextually the printed word is ሁሉ ('ይህ ሁሉ ከስንፍና አያወጣውም' — 'all this does not excuse him from negligence'), misread as ቆሎ due to heavy ink bleed on the right-side vowel rings.
